text: Fundamental Tone: Ger. Grundton ; Fr. son fondamental ; Ital. suono fondamentale , tonica . The lowest tone, or prime, in a compound tone. Literature : WUNDT, Physiol. Psychol. (4th ed.), ii. 63; STUMPF, Tonpsychologie, ii. 2; HELMHOLTZ, Sensations of Tone (3rd ed.), 22. ( E.B.T. )
